The horizontal axis is divided into three types of systems: desert steppe, meadow steppe, and farming-pastoral combination; the legend shows that the white bars are population, the dotted bars are per capita cultivated land, and the diagonal-line bars are per capita grassland. In the two types of desert steppe and meadow steppe, the per capita grassland bars are obviously higher than the per capita cultivated land bars, and grassland resources have the advantage; in the farming-pastoral combination system, per capita cultivated land increases relatively, but it still belongs to a grassland—farming-pastoral transition background. Then reason: The dominance of grassland indicates that this place is located in a temperate grassland or farming-pastoral ecotone of our country, overall tending toward arid and semi-arid, with vegetation coverage and water-source conditions not as good as humid regions, and conditions for wind erosion and soil and water loss relatively obvious. Therefore, if it is speculated that the sediment concentration of the rivers in this place is "small," it does not accord with these natural environmental characteristics and belongs to an unbelievable speculation. So the blank should be filled with "small."
